# Controllers and middleware

- Notify through `refreshUI()`, never `notifyListeners()`: it skips a disposed controller and emits the perf `ControllerNotified` record, the only trace a diagnostic has of a controller repainting. `ValidatesRequests` and `MagicStateMixin.setState` already go through it.
- A redirect-style guard overrides `MagicMiddleware.redirectTarget`, which resolves synchronously before the route builds. Redirecting from `handle()` with `MagicRoute.to()` runs after mount and remounts the destination. Return null when `location` already equals the target, or the redirect loops.
- `Kernel.resolveAll` throws a `StateError` on an alias nobody registered; never make it skip the entry. A skipped alias renders the route with no gate and reports nothing, which lets everybody through. `MagicRouter` checks every route through `Kernel.unresolvable` when it builds, so register aliases before the router builds.
- Hand a timer, poll, debouncer or subscription a controller starts to `own()` from the `OwnsTimers` mixin, so `onClose` cancels it. `own()` throws on a disposed controller, since a timer armed after `onClose` would leak.
